'''Nurls Yorksin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and served as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Yorksin was tasked with stopping contraband shipping from entering [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Nurls Yorksin was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During this time, Yorksin worked as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], gathering intelligence at the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]].<ref name="SWTORTF" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
When it came to Yorkin's attention that [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] thugs were hijacking the cargoes of honest shippers, Yorksin enlisted the help of an independent individual, as she did not wish to blow any of her fellow agents' cover. As the independent agent located Black Sun [[Labor droid/Legends|loader droids]] and downloaded their memories, the agents of Strategic Info Service were able to locate the stolen cargo and infiltrate Black Sun's warehouses.<ref name="SWTORTF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nurls Yorksin appears in the mission "The Freightskippers" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTORTF" />
